name: Winding Down
description: Layers of one pulse, each twice as fast as the next, glide together and fade in and out, so the pulse seems to slow, or quicken, without end. It only turns sound down.

params.name: Direction
params.description: Whether the pulse seems to slow down or to quicken without end. Changing it turns the glide round from where it is, with no jump.

params.name: Rate
params.description: The pulse rate a layer has when it is loudest. Each layer glides through it, and the layers twice and half as fast are quieter on either side.

params.name: Halving
params.description: How long every layer takes to halve its rate, or to double it when quickening. Short is a plain slide, long is a very slow one.

params.name: Layers
params.description: How many layers sound at once. Two is one pulse crossing over to its double, five is a thick weave from very slow pulses to a flutter.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How far the pulses turn the sound down. At zero nothing is changed. At full the sound is gone wherever every layer is in its gap.

params.name: Edge
params.description: How long each pulse takes to rise and to fall. Short is a hard chop, long is a soft swell. A fast layer keeps it to a quarter of its own period.

params.name: Offset
params.description: How far behind the left ear the right ear's pulses come, in each layer's own cycle. At 180 the ears take turns, and in mono or from one speaker no pulse is left.

origin.note: A pulse that seems to slow without end: layers of one even pulse an octave apart in rate, under a bell, read from one clock by doubling its phase.
